simklImport.howToTitle: How do I get my Simkl backup?

howTo.computerDescription: Simkl only offers backups on its website, not in its apps. Sign in at simkl.com in a web browser.
howTo.exportDescription: In the top menu, choose Apps, then the Export tab.
howTo.downloadDescription: Under ".zip archive with .json file", choose Download backup. Free accounts can do this once every 30 days, so keep the file. The .csv backup needs Simkl Pro and isn't supported yet.
howTo.chooseDescription: Move SimklBackup.zip to this device (for example with a cloud drive or email), then choose it above.

features.historyDescription: Every watched episode and movie, with the date you watched it. Episodes marked "I don't remember" use the last date you watched that show.
features.listsDescription: Plan to watch goes to Should Watch, watching and on hold go to Currently Watching, and dropped goes to Dropped. Completed shows go to Already Watched, or Currently Watching if new episodes are still coming.
features.animeDescription: Simkl splits many anime into separate seasons that number episodes differently from ShowSeek. Those episodes are only added when they can be placed exactly; the rest are listed at the end so you can add them yourself.
features.safeTitle: Your ShowSeek data stays as it is
features.safeDescription: Nothing you already track is changed. Episodes, movies and ratings already in ShowSeek are left alone.

imdbImport.description: Bring in your IMDb ratings, watchlist, custom title lists, and check-ins without replacing the rest of your ShowSeek data.

features.ratingsDescription: Movie, show, and supported episode ratings are imported when the IMDb rating is newer than what you already have.
features.listsDescription: Watchlist items merge into your default watchlist, while other IMDb title-list CSVs create or reuse matching custom lists.
features.checkinsDescription: Check-ins add movie watches, mark shows watched where supported, and update episode progress when the row maps cleanly.
features.skipsDescription: Unsupported people, images, videos, malformed rows, unresolved IMDb IDs, and list episodes are skipped and counted in the final summary.

stremio.intro: Mark what you watch in Stremio as watched in ShowSeek.
stremio.platformNotice: You'll need Stremio on a computer: the desktop app or web.stremio.com. The Android and iOS apps aren't supported yet.

setup.title: Setup Guide
setup.step1Body: This private link connects Stremio to your ShowSeek account.
setup.step1Active: Your link is active. Lost it? Create a new one and reinstall it. The old link stops working.
setup.step2Title: Send the link to your computer
setup.step2Body: Tap Share to send it to yourself by email, notes or a message. Or tap Copy.
setup.step2Pending: Your link appears here after you create it.
setup.step3Body: On your computer, open the Stremio app or web.stremio.com and click the puzzle-piece Addons icon.
setup.step4Body: Click Add addon, paste your link, then click Install.
setup.step5Body: That's it. Finish a movie or episode in Stremio and it's marked as watched in ShowSeek.

how.title: How does it work?
how.watchedTitle: When does something count as watched?
how.watchedBody: When the video ends or you close it after watching at least 80%. Skipping the end credits still counts.
how.updatesBody: The movie or episode is marked as watched, just like doing it yourself. Your auto-add and auto-remove list settings apply too.
how.devicesBody: Stremio Desktop and web.stremio.com. The Android and iOS apps don't support this yet. Your phone is only needed to create the link.
how.privacyBody: Your link is unique to your account and works like a password, so keep it to yourself. Stremio only sends which title you played and how far you got.
how.stopBody: Tap Disconnect in the Setup Guide and your link stops working right away. You can also remove the ShowSeek addon in Stremio.
how.trouble1: Watch at least 80% before closing the video.
how.trouble2: Use Stremio Desktop or Web, not the phone app.
how.trouble3: Created a new link? Reinstall the addon in Stremio with it. Old links stop working.
how.trouble4: Some titles can't be matched reliably and are skipped.
how.animeBody: Anime from Stremio's catalogs and the Anime Kitsu catalog is recorded. Episodes that can't be matched reliably are skipped.

stremio.shownOnce: This link is shown only once. A new link replaces it.

steps.step1: Open trakt.tv in your web browser and sign in.
steps.step2: Go to Settings, then select Advanced.
steps.step3: Click "Export My Data" to download your zip archive.
steps.step4: Select the downloaded .zip file above to import.

tips.title: Tips & Features
tips.intro: Handy shortcuts that are easy to miss. Most are long presses: press and hold until you feel a buzz.

addToList.title: Add to a list from anywhere
addToList.description: Long-press a movie or show poster on Home, Discover, Search and other screens to add it to a list.

watchHistory.title: See or clear your watch history
watchHistory.description: Long-press the watched button on a movie or show you've watched to see each time you watched it, or to clear it.

copyTitle.title: Copy a title
copyTitle.description: Long-press the title on a movie or show page to copy it.

poster.title: Pick a different poster
poster.description: Tap the poster on a movie or show page to choose another one. Your pick is used across the app.

actionButtons.title: Arrange the action buttons
actionButtons.description: Put the buttons on movie and show pages in the order you like in Settings › Content › Reorder Action Buttons.

favoritePeople.title: Save favorite people
favoritePeople.description: Long-press anyone in the cast or crew to add them to your favorite people.

selectSeveral.title: Select several at once
selectSeveral.description: Long-press a title in one of your lists to start selecting, then add them all to another list or remove them.

deleteLists.title: Delete lists in bulk
deleteLists.description: In Custom Lists, long-press a list to select several and delete them together.

deleteListWhileAdding.title: Delete a list while adding
deleteListWhileAdding.description: In the Add to List sheet, long-press one of your own lists to delete it.

hideShows.title: Tidy up Watch Progress
hideShows.description: Long-press a show in Watch Progress to select shows and hide them.

removeRatings.title: Remove ratings in bulk
removeRatings.description: Long-press a rating to select several and remove them at once.

savedFilters.title: Save your favorite filters
savedFilters.description: In the filters, tap Save to keep a set of filters. Long-press a saved one to rename, update or delete it.

filterChips.title: Change one filter quickly
filterChips.description: Tap a filter chip under the header to change just that filter, or its ✕ to remove it.

searchSettings.title: Search your settings
searchSettings.description: Use the search in Settings to jump straight to any option.
